original_evidence.text: | HexChat | https://github.com/hexchat/hexchat | b544ac3 / 2024-02-09 | Y (Windows only, `upd` plugin, built by default per meson boolean default) | Y (WinSparkle auto-checks on interval via `win_sparkle_init()`, plus manual `/UPDCHK`) | Y (WinSparkle downloads+runs installer) | https (`APPCAST_URL = "https://hexchat.github.io/appcast.xml"`) | no DSA/EdDSA key pinned anywhere in repo (`win_sparkle_set_dsa_pub_pem`/`_eddsa_pub_pem` never called) | **none**, confirmed by reading WinSparkle's own source directly: `updatedownloader.cpp` initializes `signatureValid = true` and, when no key is configured, only logs `"Using unsigned updates!"` and proceeds to install anyway (no Authenticode fallback exists in WinSparkle at all — checked current vslavik/winsparkle source, only DSA/EdDSA paths exist) | none pinned in repo | plugins/upd/upd.c:23-53; CI pulls WinSparkle-20151011 (.github/workflows/windows-build.yml:43); cross-checked against vslavik/winsparkle src/updatedownloader.cpp:198-219 and src/signatureverifier.cpp (only DSA-SHA1/EdDSA methods exist, no cert-matching fallback) |
